name: Hong Leong Bank Berhad
overview: 2026年，Hong Leong Bank Berhad 的公告主要涉及股息派发、股东大会及关联交易授权续期等公司治理事项，未披露各业务板块的扩张、缩减、新增或退出等具体业务变化。
overview_en: In 2026, Hong Leong Bank Berhad's announcements mainly covered dividend payments, general meetings, and renewal of shareholder mandates for recurrent related party transactions, with no disclosed business segment expansions, reductions, new businesses, or exits.
